about: Atal Realtech Ltd is a Nashik-based civil contractor executing public buildings, hospitals, educational facilities, housing, water infrastructure, roads, bridges and irrigation projects, primarily for Maharashtra government departments, PSUs and development authorities. It undertakes projects directly and through subcontracting, while wholly owned Atal Realty Ltd marks its entry into real estate and land development.
